comment: W2759 — Azure OpenAI deployments as first-class upstreams for the
IKEA Azure hub. Operator overlay TEMPLATE: copy these groups into the
machine stack.json hubs.<label>.upstreams.groups (merged over
upstreams.json by group name; hubctl push materializes the hub ladder).
Never committed as the active default — credentials live only in env
vars named by api_key_env / entra.client_secret_env, resolved by
hubctl from the stack secrets.upstream_keys paths into upstream.env
(0600, on the hub device; the value is never printed or committed).
Adapter: azure-openai (tier 2, W150) = the openai-compat pass-through
plus the Azure URL/auth profile. Two auth postures per row:
entra (preferred): adapter_config.entra client-credentials — the
gate fetches AAD tokens itself (scope cognitiveservices.azure.com
/.default, cached ~55min, single in-flight refresh); needs an
Entra app registration + secret. client_secret_env NAMES the env
var, never the secret.
api-key (fallback): api_key_env points at the env var holding the
AOAI resource key (Key Vault-sourced on the hub).
URL law: the row url is the AOAI RESOURCE endpoint
(https://<resource>.openai.azure.com); the adapter rewrites the path
to /openai/deployments/<deployment>/chat/completions and appends
api-version. adapter_config.deployment names the AOAI deployment
(defaults to the row model when omitted); adapter_config.api_version
pins the GA API (preview deployments use "preview").
Group name = the wire id lanes send; model = the served model id.
Placeholder values below — the operator's machine stack.json carries
the real resource names, deployment ids and tenant/client ids.
H100 hubs: the 4 GPU hubs expose their own buckle fronts; the Azure
hub's ladder carries one row per H100 hub (url = that hub's buckle
front, adapter = anthropic/openai per its dialect, api_key_env = the
per-label spoke key). Those rows are NOT in this template — they are
machine config (hub URLs + spoke keys exist only on the hub).
